name: Animate UI
summary: Animated React component distribution built with Tailwind CSS and Motion, installed through the shadcn CLI.
description: Not an npm library but an open distribution: animated primitives, components and icons you copy into your codebase. It covers dialogs, dropdowns, sidebars, tabs, tooltips, buttons, animated backgrounds and more, ports primitives from Radix UI, Base UI and Headless UI, and ships animated Lucide icons.
contains: animated primitives, components and icons for React
components: accordion, dialog, dropdown menu, popover, sidebar, switch, tabs, tooltip and more
8 animated buttons (liquid, ripple, flip, copy, GitHub stars and more)
7 animated backgrounds (gradient, fireworks, stars, hexagon, bubble, hole, gravity)
primitives ported from Radix UI, Base UI and Headless UI
installed with the shadcn init/add commands; code copied into your project
